limits: Finite single public ITS notice and Oct2 Payment caller; arbitrary notices, Search, list boundaries, other dates/callers and full app not_verified.
Two800ms delays are demonstration proxies; native image-loading causality, latency and exact read-mark trigger not measured.
Editable text/vector geometry and fonts/icons approximate; workshop image/static loading mark raster. Existing Payment caller lacks native unread tab badge.
First footer-background interaction removed and actual NavNotification group wired; blank-footer test stayed Payment but hotspot hint changed pixels.

First web return lost banner; later image return restored it before reupload. Same asset reuploaded and finite returns visible; long-term reliability unknown. Second loading sample lost mark; reupload and one repeat visible.
Restart click did not reset read list in saved pixels; direct known Payment start URL used. URL readback may lag. Tool screenshot preview black while actual SDK pixels show content.
Transient Calendar preview glyph positioning differed; saved stable Calendar16/38 app crops are equal. Cause unisolated; no full visual fidelity pass.
Initial/loading Back/X, menu browser/share/copy/refresh, other navigation and Calendar-read dates/modes unconfigured. Prototype replay is not native execution or human evaluation.
